title: ASCII Art Character Density Postprocess Rendering
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements a full ASCII art postprocessing pipeline. The scene renders 3D geometry into an offscreen render target, then converts the luminance of each cell into an ASCII character from a density ramp, displayed on a full-screen canvas overlay.

## Scene Setup
- Create a Three.js WebGLRenderer (hidden behind the ASCII overlay, but still rendering to an offscreen WebGLRenderTarget).
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera, FOV 60, near 0.1, far 100, positioned at (0, 2, 6) looking at origin.
- Lights: One DirectionalLight (white, intensity 1.0) at (3, 5, 4) and one AmbientLight (white, intensity 0.3).
- Scene objects:
  1. A rotating TorusKnot (radius 1.2, tube 0.4, tubularSegments 100, radialSegments 16) with MeshStandardMaterial (color #00ccff, roughness 0.4, metalness 0.6), centered at origin, rotating on Y axis at 0.5 rad/s.
  2. A static Icosahedron (radius 0.6) with MeshStandardMaterial (color #ff6600, roughness 0.3, metalness 0.8) at position (2.5, 0, -1).
  3. A ground Plane (10x10) with MeshStandardMaterial (color #333333) rotated -PI/2 on X, at y=-1.5.

## ASCII Postprocess Pipeline
- Use a WebGLRenderTarget matching the ASCII grid resolution (not the full window).
- Define a character density ramp string: ' .:-=+*#%@' (10 characters, index 0 = darkest/space, index 9 = brightest/@). Store this in window.__3D_STATE__.densityRamp.
- The ASCII grid cell size should default to 8 pixels. Store as window.__3D_STATE__.cellSize.
- Compute grid columns = floor(window.innerWidth / cellSize), rows = floor(window.innerHeight / cellSize). Store in state.
- Render the 3D scene to the offscreen target at the grid resolution.
- Read pixels via renderer.readRenderTargetPixels().
- For each cell, compute luminance = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B (R,G,B normalized 0-1).
- Map luminance to a character index: charIndex = Math.round(luminance * (rampLength - 1)).
- Draw the ASCII characters onto a 2D canvas overlay that covers the full viewport.
- Use a monospace font. Default font size = cellSize. Default foreground color = '#00ff00' (green). Default background = '#000000'.

## Color Modes
- Support 3 color modes cycled by pressing 'C' key:
  0: 'mono' — all characters drawn in the foreground color (green).
  1: 'luminance' — characters drawn with grayscale rgb(lum*255, lum*255, lum*255).
  2: 'original' — characters drawn with the actual RGB color sampled from that cell.
- Store current mode index in window.__3D_STATE__.colorMode (0, 1, or 2).
- Store mode name in window.__3D_STATE__.colorModeName.

## Density Ramp Inversion
- Pressing 'I' key toggles inversion of the density ramp (reverse the string). Store window.__3D_STATE__.inverted (boolean).

## Cell Size Adjustment
- Press '+' (or '=') to increase cellSize by 2 (max 24).
- Press '-' to decrease cellSize by 2 (min 4).
- Changing cell size must recompute grid columns/rows and resize the render target.

## Brightness / Contrast
- Press ArrowUp to increase brightness offset by 0.05 (max 1.0). Press ArrowDown to decrease (min -1.0). Default 0.0. Store in window.__3D_STATE__.brightness.
- Press ArrowRight to increase contrast multiplier by 0.1 (max 3.0). Press ArrowLeft to decrease (min 0.1). Default 1.0. Store in window.__3D_STATE__.contrast.
- Apply before character mapping: adjustedLum = clamp((luminance - 0.5) * contrast + 0.5 + brightness, 0, 1).

## Custom Ramp Input
- Add a text input element with id='rampInput' pre-filled with the default ramp string.
- Add a button with id='applyRamp' that, when clicked, reads the input value and replaces the density ramp. Update window.__3D_STATE__.densityRamp and window.__3D_STATE__.rampLength.

## Rotation Toggle
- Press 'Space' to pause/resume the torusKnot rotation. Store window.__3D_STATE__.rotating (boolean, default true).
- Store window.__3D_STATE__.torusRotationY (current Y rotation in radians).

## Undo/Redo for Cell Size
- Maintain an undo stack for cellSize changes. Press 'U' to undo last cellSize change. Press 'R' to redo. Store window.__3D_STATE__.cellSizeHistory (array of past values) and window.__3D_STATE__.cellSizeRedoStack (array).

## HUD Overlay
- Display a semi-transparent HUD div (id='hud') in the top-left corner showing:
  - Cell Size, Grid (cols x rows), Color Mode name, Inverted status, Brightness, Contrast, Ramp length, Rotating status.
- Update every frame.

## State Object (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose ALL of the following on window.__3D_STATE__ and update every frame:
- cellSize (number), columns (number), rows (number)
- colorMode (0|1|2), colorModeName ('mono'|'luminance'|'original')
- inverted (boolean)
- brightness (number), contrast (number)
- densityRamp (string), rampLength (number)
- rotating (boolean), torusRotationY (number)
- cellSizeHistory (array), cellSizeRedoStack (array)
- frameCount (number, incremented each frame)
- lastLuminanceSample (number, the luminance of the center cell of the grid after adjustment)
- totalCells (number, columns * rows)
- rendererReady (boolean, true after first frame)

Ensure the animation loop runs via requestAnimationFrame. The page must be fully self-contained in one HTML file with no external dependencies except Three.js from CDN (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r152/three.min.js).
physics_constraints: Luminance computation must follow ITU-R BT.709: L = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B. Brightness/contrast adjustment: adjustedLum = clamp((L - 0.5) * contrast + 0.5 + brightness, 0, 1). Character index = Math.round(adjustedLum * (rampLength - 1)). Cell size clamped [4, 24]. Brightness clamped [-1, 1]. Contrast clamped [0.1, 3.0]. Grid dimensions: cols = floor(viewportWidth / cellSize), rows = floor(viewportHeight / cellSize). totalCells = cols * rows.
